steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The oikos (household) was the basic social unit: the male head (kyrios) controlled the family, property and dependants | Key Fact: Athenian women lived largely secluded lives in the women's quarters (gynaikeion); they could not vote, own property or conduct business independently | Key Fact: The symposium was an elite male drinking party featuring conversation, music and entertainment; it was central to aristocratic social and political networking | Key Fact: Slavery was fundamental to the Athenian economy: slaves worked in homes, workshops, mines and fields; they had no legal rights

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from athenian daily life &amp; society, and one past-paper question.
